# Reviewed generated Swift API shape. Generated by `just binding snapshot-update`.

struct AdapterSnapshot {
    public var state: AdapterState
    public var scanAuthorization: AuthorizationState
    public var connectionAuthorization: AuthorizationState
    public var name: String?
}

enum AdapterState {
    case unknown
    case unavailable
    case poweredOff
    case poweredOn
}

struct AdvertisementObservation {
    public var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId
    public var peripheralId: PeripheralId
    public var localName: String?
    public var advertisedServices: [BluetoothUuid]
    public var manufacturerData: [ManufacturerData]
    public var serviceData: [ServiceData]
    public var rssi: Int16?
    public var connectable: Bool?
}

enum AuthorizationState {
    case notRequired
    case notDetermined
    case denied
    case restricted
    case authorized
}

struct BackendCapabilities {
    public var platform: Platform
    public var contractVersion: UInt32
    public var supportsDuplicateScanResults: Bool
    public var supportsConnectableFlag: Bool
    public var supportsReadRssi: Bool
    public var supportsRequiredNotification: Bool
    public var supportsRequiredIndication: Bool
    public var reportsActualNotificationMode: Bool
}

class BackendEventIngressHandle : BackendEventIngressHandleProtocol

protocol BackendEventIngressHandleProtocol {
    func push(event: BleEvent) -> EventIngressStatus
}

protocol BleBackend {
    func capabilities() throws -> BackendCapabilities
    func bindEventIngress(ingress: BackendEventIngressHandle) throws
    func initialize(command: InitializeCommand) throws
    func startScan(command: StartScanCommand) throws
    func stopScan(command: StopScanCommand) throws
    func connect(command: ConnectCommand) throws
    func disconnect(command: DisconnectCommand) throws
    func discoverGatt(command: DiscoverGattCommand) throws
    func readCharacteristic(command: ReadCharacteristicCommand) throws
    func writeCharacteristic(command: WriteCharacteristicCommand) throws
    func setNotifications(command: SetNotificationsCommand) throws
    func readRssi(command: ReadRssiCommand) throws
    func cancelOperation(request: CancelOperationRequest) throws
    func dispose() throws
}

enum BleErrorCategory {
    case permission
    case adapterUnavailable
    case invalidState
    case notFound
    case timeout
    case cancelled
    case operationAborted
    case connection
    case gatt
    case `protocol`
    case notSupported
    case backend
    case `internal`
}

enum BleEvent {
    case adapterSnapshotChanged(commandId: CommandId?, snapshot: AdapterSnapshot)
    case scanStarted(commandId: CommandId, scanId: ScanSessionId)
    case advertisementObserved(advertisement: AdvertisementObservation)
    case scanStopped(scanId: ScanSessionId, result: ScanStopResult)
    case connectionStateChanged(commandId: CommandId?, connectionId: ConnectionId, result: ConnectionStateResult)
    case gattDiscovered(commandId: CommandId, database: GattDatabase)
    case characteristicRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, value: Data)
    case characteristicWritten(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId)
    case notificationStateChanged(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, subscriptionId: SubscriptionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, state: NotificationState)
    case notificationReceived(connectionId: ConnectionId, gattSessionId: GattSessionId, subscriptionId: SubscriptionId, characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId, value: Data)
    case rssiRead(commandId: CommandId, connectionId: ConnectionId, rssi: Int16)
    case commandCompleted(commandId: CommandId, error: BleEventError?)
    case backendError(error: BleEventError)
}

struct BleEventError {
    public var category: BleErrorCategory
    public var message: String
    public var platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?
}

protocol BleEventSink {
    func onEvent(event: BleEvent) throws
}

enum BleHubError {
    case BackendAssembly(detail: String)
    case BackendCleanup(detail: String, platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?)
    case ResourceBusy(detail: String)
    case InvalidConfiguration(field: String, detail: String)
    case FfiContract(detail: String)
}

protocol BleHubProtocol {
    func cancelOperation(targetCommandId: CommandId) throws
    func capabilities() -> BackendCapabilities
    func connect(command: ConnectCommand) throws
    func disconnect(command: DisconnectCommand) throws
    func discoverGatt(command: DiscoverGattCommand) throws
    func dispose() throws
    func initialize(command: InitializeCommand) throws
    func readCharacteristic(command: ReadCharacteristicCommand) throws
    func readRssi(command: ReadRssiCommand) throws
    func setNotifications(command: SetNotificationsCommand) throws
    func startScan(command: StartScanCommand) throws
    func stopScan(command: StopScanCommand) throws
    func writeCharacteristic(command: WriteCharacteristicCommand) throws
}

struct BluetoothUuid {
    public var value: String
}

struct CancelOperationRequest {
    public var targetCommandId: CommandId
}

struct CharacteristicProperties {
    public var readable: Bool
    public var writableWithResponse: Bool
    public var writableWithoutResponse: Bool
    public var notifiable: Bool
    public var indicatable: Bool
}

enum CommandDispatchError {
    case Closed
    case InvalidRequest(detail: String)
    case InvalidState(detail: String)
    case OperationNotFound(targetCommandId: CommandId)
    case OperationAlreadyCompleted(targetCommandId: CommandId)
    case OperationNotCancellable(targetCommandId: CommandId)
    case ResourceExhausted(detail: String)
    case BackendUnavailable(detail: String, platformDetails: PlatformErrorDetails?)
    case FfiContract(detail: String)
}

struct CommandId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

enum CommandKind {
    case initialize
    case startScan
    case stopScan
    case connect
    case disconnect
    case discoverGatt
    case readCharacteristic
    case writeCharacteristic
    case setNotifications
    case readRssi
}

struct ConnectCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var peripheralId: PeripheralId
}

struct ConnectionId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

enum ConnectionState {
    case connecting
    case connected
    case disconnecting
    case disconnected
}

enum ConnectionStateResult {
    case ok(state: ConnectionState)
    case err(error: BleEventError)
}

struct DisconnectCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
}

struct DiscoverGattCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var gattSessionId: GattSessionId
}

enum EventIngressStatus {
    case delivered
    case closed
    case invalidEvent(message: String)
    case downstreamFailed(message: String)
}

enum EventSinkError {
    case Rejected(detail: String)
    case UnexpectedCallback(detail: String)
}

struct GattCharacteristic {
    public var id: GattCharacteristicId
    public var uuid: BluetoothUuid
    public var properties: CharacteristicProperties
    public var descriptors: [GattDescriptor]
}

struct GattCharacteristicId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

struct GattDatabase {
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var gattSessionId: GattSessionId
    public var services: [GattService]
}

struct GattDescriptor {
    public var id: GattDescriptorId
    public var uuid: BluetoothUuid
}

struct GattDescriptorId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

struct GattService {
    public var id: GattServiceId
    public var uuid: BluetoothUuid
    public var primary: Bool?
    public var characteristics: [GattCharacteristic]
}

struct GattServiceId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

struct GattSessionId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

struct InitializeCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
}

struct ManufacturerData {
    public var companyId: UInt16
    public var payload: Data
}

enum NotificationAction {
    case enable(mode: NotificationModeRequest)
    case disable
}

enum NotificationMode {
    case notification
    case indication
}

enum NotificationModeRequest {
    case platformDefault
    case requireNotification
    case requireIndication
}

enum NotificationState {
    case enabled(actualMode: NotificationMode?)
    case disabled
}

struct PeripheralId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

enum Platform {
    case windows
    case android
    case apple
    case linux
    case test
}

struct PlatformErrorDetails {
    public var platform: Platform
    public var code: String?
    public var name: String?
    public var message: String?
}

struct ReadCharacteristicCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var gattSessionId: GattSessionId
    public var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId
}

struct ReadRssiCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
}

struct ScanOptions {
    public var serviceUuids: [BluetoothUuid]
    public var namePrefix: String?
    public var companyId: UInt16?
    public var allowDuplicates: Bool
}

struct ScanSessionId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

enum ScanStopReason {
    case requested(commandId: CommandId)
    case systemSuspended
}

enum ScanStopResult {
    case ok(reason: ScanStopReason)
    case err(error: BleEventError)
}

struct ServiceData {
    public var serviceUuid: BluetoothUuid
    public var payload: Data
}

struct SetNotificationsCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var gattSessionId: GattSessionId
    public var subscriptionId: SubscriptionId
    public var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId
    public var action: NotificationAction
}

struct StartScanCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId
    public var options: ScanOptions
}

struct StopScanCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var scanSessionId: ScanSessionId
}

struct SubscriptionId {
    public var value: UInt64
}

struct WriteCharacteristicCommand {
    public var commandId: CommandId
    public var connectionId: ConnectionId
    public var gattSessionId: GattSessionId
    public var characteristicId: GattCharacteristicId
    public var value: Data
    public var writeType: WriteType
}

enum WriteType {
    case withResponse
    case withoutResponse
}
